title: PRD B — Voice-friendly action results
source_plan: User found that list_profiles dumps an ASCII table into TTS — the bot literally tries to read pipes and dashes. Root cause: tool execution result.output is the same string used for TTS. Fix: each direct tool ships a separate spoken summary (per language) that the action callback uses for the TTS frame; raw output continues to feed logs and dashboard.
notes: Builds on i18n PRD A. Spoken templates are per-language ({en,uk,ru}) and resolved via intent.language. Falls back to English then to truncated output. Touches src/actions.py (Intent.language), src/direct_tools.py (every handler returns spoken), src/main.py (_persist_action_outcome resolves per language), src/generator.py (intent submit carries _active_lang). Does NOT touch tool_registry, prompts/, speaker code.

stories.title: Intent carries language; spoken contract documented
stories.description: Extend src/actions.Intent dataclass with `language: str = "en"`. IntentQueue.submit accepts an optional `language` kwarg and forwards it onto the Intent instance it creates. Generator (src/generator.py _submit_intent or wherever IntentQueue.submit is called) passes `language=self._active_lang`. Document in src/direct_tools.py module docstring and execute_direct return-value docstring that handlers MAY return `spoken: dict[str, str] | str | None` (lang→sentence map, single sentence, or omitted).
acceptanceCriteria: src/actions.py Intent dataclass has new field `language: str = "en"` after transcript_id (defaults preserve back-compat).
src/actions.py IntentQueue.submit signature gains keyword-only `language: str = "en"`, forwards onto Intent.
src/generator.py: every IntentQueue.submit(...) call site passes `language=self._active_lang`.
src/direct_tools.py: execute_direct docstring describes `spoken` field in the return dict (optional, dict[lang,str] | str | None, English required when present).
tests/test_actions.py: a new test verifies Intent.language defaults to "en" AND a non-default value (e.g. "uk") round-trips through submit→next.
uv run pytest tests/test_actions.py tests/test_generator.py -q exits 0
uv run ruff check src/actions.py src/direct_tools.py src/generator.py exits 0

stories.title: Profile tool spoken templates (list/create/rename/delete/re_enroll)
stories.description: Each profile-related direct-tool handler in src/direct_tools.py returns a `spoken` dict with en/uk/ru entries. Templates are short, voice-friendly sentences — never the raw output. Templates use Python str.format with the tool's resolved values.
acceptanceCriteria: _execute_list_profiles returns spoken={"en": "You have N profile(s): <names>.", "uk": "У тебе N профілів: <names>.", "ru": "У тебя N профилей: <names>."} (or singular variant for N=1; comma-joined names with last "and"/"і"/"и"). Empty case: "No voice profiles yet." / "Профілів поки немає." / "Профилей пока нет."
_execute_create_profile returns spoken={"en": "Created profile <name>.", "uk": "Створив профіль <name>.", "ru": "Создал профиль <name>."}.
_execute_rename_profile returns spoken={"en": "Renamed <id> to <new_label>.", "uk": "Перейменував <id> на <new_label>.", "ru": "Переименовал <id> в <new_label>."}.
_execute_delete_profile returns spoken={"en": "Deleted profile <id>.", "uk": "Видалив профіль <id>.", "ru": "Удалил профиль <id>."}.
_execute_re_enroll returns spoken={"en": "Voice profile updated.", "uk": "Голосовий профіль оновлено.", "ru": "Голосовой профиль обновлён."}.
Error paths still return success=False with a spoken dict where the en variant is short and voice-friendly (e.g. "Profile owner cannot be deleted.").
tests/test_direct_tools.py adds at least one spoken-content assertion per profile tool (5+ new assertions).

stories.title: System tool spoken templates (bash/read/write)
stories.description: bash, read, write handlers in src/direct_tools.py return spoken templates that NEVER dump raw stdout/file content into TTS. Short, deterministic phrases.
acceptanceCriteria: _execute_bash success path returns spoken={"en":"Done.","uk":"Виконано.","ru":"Готово."} when stdout is empty or longer than 80 chars; when stdout is non-empty AND ≤ 80 chars, en is "Done. <stdout>" (uk/ru similar). Multi-line stdout is collapsed/truncated.
_execute_bash error path returns spoken={"en":"Command failed.","uk":"Команда не виконалася.","ru":"Команда не выполнилась."} (no raw stderr in spoken).
_execute_read returns spoken={"en":"Read N lines.","uk":"Прочитав N рядків.","ru":"Прочитал N строк."} on success; "File not found." / Ukrainian / Russian on missing file.
_execute_write returns spoken={"en":"File saved.","uk":"Файл збережено.","ru":"Файл сохранён."}; error variant short.

stories.title: _on_action_result/_on_action_error consume spoken with language resolution
stories.description: Update src/main.py _on_action_result and _on_action_error to resolve spoken from the action result dict using intent.language. New helper `_resolve_spoken(result, intent, fallback_summary)` lives in main.py (or a tiny helper module): if result['spoken'] is a dict, pick by intent.language with 'en' fallback; if it's a str, use as-is; if missing/None, fall back to truncated `_spoken_action_summary(...)` of the raw output (current behavior). _persist_action_outcome continues to write the resolved text into the decisions(speak) row.
acceptanceCriteria: src/main.py defines `_resolve_spoken(result: dict, intent: Intent, fallback_summary: str) -> str` (or equivalent) at module scope.
_on_action_result calls _resolve_spoken instead of using the raw `summary` for the spoken frame; logs `[ACTION SPEAK id=N len=M]` with the resolved text length.

_on_action_error: existing `hint = _action_error_hint(exc)` path remains for non-tool errors; when the worker delivers a structured ActionResult error (with spoken), prefer that over the generic hint.

tests/test_main.py adds: (a) test_resolve_spoken_picks_language_from_dict, (b) test_resolve_spoken_falls_back_to_english_for_unknown_language, (c) test_resolve_spoken_str_form_used_as_is, (d) test_resolve_spoken_none_falls_back_to_summary.

Existing integration test tests/integration/test_intent_flow.py — `test_intent_flow_persists_full_turn_to_store` still passes; the spoken decision row now contains the templated sentence, not the raw output.

stories.title: Claude/MCP/workflow fallback spoken (generic 'Done.' per language)
stories.description: Direct tools all ship spoken templates after VFA-02..04. For Claude/MCP/workflow tools (which return free-form output), the action worker has no per-tool spoken. _resolve_spoken falls back to a generic per-language 'Done.' rather than dumping the Claude/MCP/workflow output into TTS. Errors fall back to a generic 'Action failed.' per language.
acceptanceCriteria: _resolve_spoken from VFA-05: when result lacks 'spoken' AND result['success'] is True, returns generic per-lang Done sentence ({en:'Done.', uk:'Готово.', ru:'Готово.'}) keyed by intent.language; fallback English.

_resolve_spoken when result lacks 'spoken' AND result['success'] is False, returns generic per-lang 'Action failed.' ({en:'Action failed.', uk:'Не вдалося виконати.', ru:'Не удалось выполнить.'}); preserves intent.language.

Existing _spoken_action_summary helper kept as last-resort fallback ONLY when the raw output is short (<60 chars) and from a clearly direct tool — otherwise the generic Done sentence wins, so MCP/workflow output never flows into TTS.
tests/test_main.py adds: test_resolve_spoken_generic_done_per_language and test_resolve_spoken_generic_failure_per_language.
uv run pytest tests/test_main.py -q exits 0
uv run ruff check src/main.py tests/test_main.py exits 0
